keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Salamanca UDS 0, Celta Vigo 1. Ferran Jutglà (Celta Vigo) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Germain Miller.
Goal! Salamanca UDS 0, Celta Vigo 2. Ferran Jutglà (Celta Vigo) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Aleix Febas with a through ball.
Goal! Salamanca UDS 0, Celta Vigo 3. Andrés Antañón (Celta Vigo) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Ángel Arcos.
Substitution, Salamanca UDS. Larry Opara replaces Markel Ucín.
Substitution, Salamanca UDS. Willian Peña replaces Adur Alsua.
Second Half begins Salamanca UDS 0, Celta Vigo 3.
Delay in match because of an injury Javier Murúa (Salamanca UDS).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Javier Murúa (Salamanca UDS) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Máximo Levrand (Salamanca UDS) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Salamanca UDS. Sanvi replaces Urki Txoperena.
Substitution, Salamanca UDS. Luis Bilbao replaces Álex Caramelo.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Pablo Durán replaces Germain Miller.
Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Iago Aspas replaces Ferran Jutglà.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Vladimir Silva replaces Hugo González.
Substitution, Salamanca UDS. Óscar León replaces Carlos Cristeto.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Couhaib Driouech replaces Ángel Arcos.
Substitution, Celta Vigo. Williot Swedberg replaces Andrés Antañón.
Goal! Salamanca UDS 0, Celta Vigo 4. Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Iago Aspas.
Goal! Salamanca UDS 0, Celta Vigo 5. Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Javi Galán.
Delay in match (Celta Vigo).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Larry Opara (Salamanca UDS) is shown the yellow card.
